description: Evals cho QD11 Business Completeness & Enhancement Lane — kiem tra skip conditions, 3-pass LLM signal emission, va CDG gate cho enhancement suggestions.

test_cases.name: Multi-module project → QD11 emits MISSING_FIELD signals (Pass 1 cross-module)

input.scenario: Project co 2 modules cung domain (CRM + Sales). Module CRM co CustomerForm voi field tax_id, module Sales co CustomerForm khong co tax_id.

test_cases.validation: Pass 1 phat hien CustomerForm trong module sales thieu field tax_id so voi CRM. Severity MEDIUM (MISSING_FIELD). Confidence HIGH (so sanh cung entity type).

test_cases.name: Single-module project → QD11 skips

input.scenario: Project chi co 1 module duy nhat. Khong co module khac de cross-reference.

test_cases.validation: QD11 PRE-GATE detect single_module → skip. KHONG emit signals. Ghi lane-status.json voi status=skipped, reason=single_module.

test_cases.name: API-only project → QD11 skips

input.scenario: Project la API-only backend, khong co form/UI module de so sanh business pattern.

test_cases.validation: QD11 PRE-GATE detect interface_type=api-only → skip. KHONG emit signals. Ghi lane-status.json voi status=skipped, reason=api_only.

test_cases.name: Pass 2 domain heuristic phat hien MISSING_DOMAIN_FIELD (Healthcare)

input.scenario: Healthcare module co Patient entity nhung thieu MRN (Medical Record Number). Domain rules trong .claude/references/team-expert/healthcare/ yeu cau MRN cho moi patient record.

test_cases.validation: Pass 2 phat hien Patient entity thieu MRN field theo healthcare domain rules. Severity HIGH (mandatory clinical field). Confidence MEDIUM (best practice, khong phai hard code requirement).

test_cases.name: Pass 3 registry gap phat hien UNIMPLEMENTED_REQ (req in registry but no code)

input.scenario: req-registry.json co requirement REQ-CRM-005 voi impl_status=not_started nhung related scope modules da duoc implement. Requirement lien quan den tinh nang export reports.

test_cases.validation: Pass 3 phat hien REQ-CRM-005 trong registry voi impl_status=not_started nhung cac REQ lien quan da done → suggest day la gap can duoc implement. Severity HIGH (missing feature). Confidence HIGHEST (registry SSOT).
